authority: Owner-approved re-identification of model manifests listed under unsanitizedExceptions.model-manifest-identity in manifest.json (2026-10-30 sanitization).
scope: Model manifests whose source or sourceCheckpointId (and one conversionConfigPath) held a machine home-directory path, plus every committed digest that cites them.

identityFunctions.manifestSha256: sha256 of the manifest text: sha256ManifestText in src/client/runtime/model-source.js; this is the manifestHash/manifestDigest/manifestSha256 that receipts and weightsRef cite.
identityFunctions.manifestStableDigest: hashStableJson(manifest) in src/tooling/browser-harness/request.js; browser-harness reports and provider receipts cite it as manifestDigest or resolvedArtifactVariantId.

method: Only path-valued fields changed. Hugging Face cache snapshot paths became <org>/<name>@<revision>; other source paths became the manifest's own artifactIdentity.sourceCheckpointId; paths inside the repository became repository-relative.
Both identities were issued by running the runtime functions above on the old and new manifest bytes.

Every digest naming a changed manifest, archive or citing file was rebound bottom-up to a fixpoint, through gzip and tar members, with adjacent byte counts. Stable-JSON digests stored inside a changed receipt (runtimeProfileHash, referenceDigest, receiptDigest) were recomputed with the same hashStableJson. Product-integration evidence digests and evidenceSetDigest were recomputed with tools/lib/canonical-json.js and tools/lib/product-integration-evidence.js.
Signatures, git revisions, shard-set digests, weight-pack digests, conversion-config digests, inference and execution digests were not changed.
markers: Updated JSON evidence carries pathSanitized: true and pathSanitization pointing here; evidence already marked by the 2026-10-30 pass carries modelManifestReidentification pointing here. Model manifests and the strict product-integration receipts listed in unmarkedStrictReceipts carry no marker.
qualificationNote: Rebinding transfers no new qualification. Receipts now name the re-identified manifest whose only difference from the executed one is the listed path fields; the executed bytes are the originals kept privately.
privateOriginals: The exact original bytes are retained by the maintainers outside every repository; originalSha256 identifies them.
